users: researchers curating source-linked multiphase heat-transfer literature catalogs
supported_tasks: extract paper-backed dataset and operating-envelope metadata
verify source quotes and build a reviewable catalog
not_intended_for: using agent-extracted values as unreviewed engineering inputs, inferring an application target without human confirmation, or redistributing source PDFs and figures without rights review

required_inputs: controlled taxonomy and human review process

limitations: Application inference is explicitly a hallucination hotspot and must be confirmed by a human.
Digitized curves and extracted values remain source-dependent and require review before engineering use.
